title: Optical voltage trace to independently recorded spike timing across complete cell recordings

evidence.supports: Preserved older task bytes, including historical seven-mouse/six-title-token uncertainty and nominal-rate formulation.
Complete metadata census establishes six declared subjects, twelve cells, 34 movies and native-time successor direction; physical signals remain undecoded.
Six-subject/12-cell/34-movie complete native-frame scoring with exact 5-ms one-to-one matching, grouped F1 and private representation ceiling.
Explicit current prospective endpoint, input/output contracts and generated-control limitations.
Retained notebook/source inspection: frame centers already use electrical time; deposited 10-kHz export differs from paper acquisition; no recovered electrical spike detector.

evidence.locator: Primary acquisition paper; inspected method passages retained in clock/electrical report
evidence.supports: Optical/electrical voltage comparison; the historical five-cell smoothed waveform-RMS comparison differs from the prospective event-F1 endpoint.

evidence.locator: Versioned Janelia collection; complete metadata census retained in data-scope review
evidence.supports: Deposited twelve-cell collection and original optical/electrical recordings.

evidence.locator: Author using_ground_truth_data.ipynb; complete 21-cell source inspection retained in clock/electrical report
evidence.supports: Exposure-midpoint frame times relative to electrophysiology and time/voltage/stimulus sweep channels.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Existing source and generated engineering controls are preserved. No authentic model comparison, direct-observation trial, typed-viewer trial or human performance result is established for this registration.
excluded_claims: Raw-video understanding, paper waveform reproduction, authentic spike detection or human-equivalent accuracy.
Six metadata subject groups treated as independently validated mice or electrical exactness treated as physical clock certainty.

disposition_reason: The current six-subject native-frame event scorer is delivered as a source component. This revision adopts its explicit 12-cell/34-movie deposited scope and replaces the stale nominal-clock/seven-group assumptions. Authentic optical extraction, electrical reference events and participant access remain unqualified.

scientific_target.question: Across all 34 deposited movies from twelve cells in six declared subjects, can optical-only voltage traces identify independently adjudicated electrical spike events in a subject excluded from fitting?
scientific_target.known_answer: Electrophysiological spike-event times at authentic electrical sample locations, adjudicated independently of optical predictions; the present repository has no complete qualified event reference.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original whole-cell voltage sweeps, with electrical-only event and valid-support annotation fixed before optical predictions. The author notebook supplies channel/time semantics but no recoverable spike detector; reference production is a prospective benchmark procedure.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete movie, partitioned into exhaustive nonoverlapping optical frame cores for submission and reassembled before event matching.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Six deposited subject groups from the complete metadata census; verify the biological grouping before population inference. Twelve cells and 34 movies are nested, not independent subjects.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Derived optical-trace spike reconstruction at native frame-center resolution, with at most one predicted event per frame. It neither evaluates raw-video understanding nor reproduces the paper’s waveform-RMS comparison.
exclusions: No seven-animal score from the historical mathematical interface; paper seven-mouse discrepancy remains disclosed.
No subframe spike localization or same-frame multiplicity claim.
No physical clock validation from exact arithmetic or metadata alone.

inputs: Complete optical voltage trace from label-independent ROI/background/motion processing, native exposure-midpoint timestamps and optical-only quality support. Trace preparation is not yet qualified.
Known indicator polarity/exposure and identical training-cell calibration across all six held-subject folds. Native frame values must be preserved; nominal 400/1000 Hz are stratum labels only.
forbidden_inputs: Patch voltage, injected-current channel, held spike annotations or electrically optimized ROI/denoising/templates/thresholds.
Electrical-derived support/representation-ceiling events, held-subject calibration outcomes or original answer-bearing source names.
observation_contract.case_identity: Current scorer requires exactly 12 opaque cells, 34 opaque movies and exhaustive core_id frame partitions, joined privately to six subjects and six outer_folds. Authentic public packet/opaque map is not delivered; hashes identify supplied artifacts rather than establish biological provenance.
observation_contract.split: The native-frame scorer requires one outer fold per declared subject with every other subject’s cells as training cells; all movies follow their cell’s subject. Calibrate optical comparators on training/development only. This verifies a supplied map, not independent animal identity or training behavior.
observation_contract.coverage: All twelve deposited cells and all 34 movies, including extraction failures, partial validity and undefined cells. Metadata census replaces filename-only six-token observation; paper methods’ seven-mouse count remains an unresolved source discrepancy. Full signal decoding and optical/electrical support are not established.

primary.name: Six subject-specific equal-cell event F1 values
primary.aggregation: Match predicted native frame centers to electrical events at inclusive exact 5 ms with maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching inside each connected valid interval; sum TP/FP/FN over all movies of a cell, compute cell F1, then equally weight cells within each subject. No cross-subject primary scalar.
primary.rationale: Scores independent electrical event recovery without empty-window inflation, movie fragmentation or high-rate-cell dominance; all biological groups remain visible.

secondary: Precision, recall, false events per valid minute, deterministic matched latency and absolute latency.
Complete/valid duration, failed/partial/unscorable movies and predictions outside valid support at movie/cell/subject levels.
Nominal 400/1000-Hz metadata strata, observed-only subject means explicitly secondary.
Evaluator-private output-representation recall/F1 ceiling from matching every eligible native frame center after all predictions are frozen; this is not optical recoverability.

comparators.name: Optical MAD threshold
comparators.inputs: Identical optical traces, native clocks and permitted training calibration.
comparators.procedure: Required optical_mad prediction role; fit threshold/refractory policy only on training subjects. Scorer authenticates complete artifacts, not their producer or competence.

comparators.name: Optical matched filter
comparators.inputs: Same trace-only substrate and training labels.
comparators.procedure: Required optical_matched_filter role with train-only templates/thresholds; no electrical test template selection.

comparators.name: Metadata/rate prior
comparators.inputs: Only permitted polarity/exposure/camera metadata and training event rate.
comparators.procedure: Required metadata_rate role; controls gain available without the optical waveform. A full-video VolPy pipeline is richer-input auxiliary unless trace parity is proved.

nuisance_controls: Within-movie optical-to-patch block reassignment preserving duration and nuisance strata; complete recording support required.
Keep actual stored exposure-midpoint clock; do not add movie/sweep start twice or replace it with a nominal grid.
Resolve deposited 10-kHz electrical export versus paper 100-kHz acquisition and acquisition-filter metadata; do not infer anti-aliasing or physical synchronization.
Electrical-only blinded reference/quality decisions precede optical predictions; keep source gaps and failed extraction rather than choose easy intervals.
evaluation.uncertainty: Primary is six individual subject-specific vectors and paired comparator differences, including negative/undefined values. Scorer supplies no significance or improvement threshold. Any later uncertainty must resample verified subjects and preserve nested cells/movies.
evaluation.failure_policy: Every role must submit every core with sorted unique literal frame indices, at most one event per frame; invalid submissions are rejected before private reference access. Empty/empty F1 is undefined, not perfect. Undefined cells keep the full subject mean undefined; extraction failures and unscorable coverage never disappear.

implementation.scorer_target: Prospective native-frame spike-event endpoint, not the historical seven-group integer-grid scorer or source-paper waveform RMS. grade captures all candidate/comparator predictions before one private callback and returns six subject F1 vectors plus coverage.
implementation.delivered_scope: Exact arithmetic event-scoring library, complete metadata census and bounded structural clock/electrical decoder source. Generated tests cover matching, coverage, malformed input and undefined outcomes; no authentic optical/electrical inference is established.
missing: Complete authentic optical trace producer with independently justified patched-cell ROI and motion/exposure history.
Native time/voltage/stimulus decoding and electrical-only spike/support annotation with physical alignment review.
Qualified train-only comparator producers and protected direct/viewer/tool/program participant transports.
implementation.execution_evidence: Existing generated controls and metadata/source review are documented; no authentic signal model evaluation or new model/human experiment was performed in this revision.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed numeric or fixed waveform-image optical trace tiles retaining complete frame cores and declared context halos.
direct_observation.boundary: No tools and no patch channel; outputs remain native frame indices with at most one event per frame. Full-frame coverage must match programme arms.
missing: No authentic optical trace packets, direct image/numeric transport or full response collection.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed optical trace viewer with native time axis, polarity/exposure and bounded zoom.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only optical observations; electrical labels, private validity, raw hidden channels and representation ceiling stay evaluator-only.
missing: No typed viewer/action protocol or image delivery for this registration.

tool_assisted.representation: Per-movie numerical optical event analysis with fixed permitted tools/checkpoints.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same trace/calibration/halo substrate as other arms; richer-video processing is a separately labelled condition; no score feedback during held inference.
missing: No per-case investigation runner, authentic matched packets or resource logs.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted optical trace-to-frame-event programme plus train-only calibration recipe.
frozen_program.boundary: Scorer requires programme/calibration digests and complete predictions but does not execute or verify the producer; freeze before held-subject access.
missing: No qualified optical comparator/candidate producer or protected programme execution.

summary: Adopts complete six-deposited-subject/twelve-cell/34-movie native-frame scope and preserves historical seven-mouse discrepancy.
Corrects known-answer status: electrical event annotations are not recovered author labels; their independent production remains required.
Makes one-event-per-native-frame output resolution, exact connected-interval matching and undefined-cell handling explicit.
Separates derived-trace interpretation from raw-video assistance and scorer-only programme digest fields from actual execution.
revision.source_review: Reviewed original definition, complete metadata scope report, native event source/contract and complete retained clock/electrical source review. Primary paper/collection/loader evidence reused from those verified records; no new payload acquisition.
